metadata.name: Product & Context Graph Engine
metadata.description: Multi-project graph model (PRD-002/ADR-002): unified product, architecture, code and drift context, isolated per project inside a single Neo4j Community instance.
metadata.format: mcp-neo4j-data-modeling DataModel (nodes/relationships/metadata); validated with mcp-neo4j-data-modeling@0.8.2 via scripts/validate-graph-model.mjs
metadata.sourceOfTruth: packages/core/src/graph/migrations.ts (schema), packages/core/src/graph/queries.ts + store-write.ts + store-read.ts (shape), packages/core/src/domain/schema.ts + parser/frontmatter.ts (node/edge derivation)

nodes.label: Node
nodes.description: Base label carried by every document-derived node, always combined with exactly one subtype label (Feature|Blueprint|WorkOrder|Artifact|Feedback). The `node_project_id` composite constraint and the `node_text_v2` fulltext index are declared on this label, not on the subtypes.

key_property.name: id
key_property.description: Document id, e.g. PRD-002 (matches ID_PATTERN ^(MRD|PRD|FR|SDD|ADR|WO|ART|FB)-\d{3,9}$). Unique only in combination with project_id (see x-prdm.constraints.node_project_id) -- this tool has no composite-key concept.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: Always equal to id; the stable identifier returned to callers in search/branch/fullGraph/getNode/workOrderContext projections.

properties.name: project_id
properties.description: Required. prj_ + 16 hex chars (ADR-002 D6); isolates this project's partition. Validated against PROJECT_ID_PATTERN before it reaches the fulltext query (ADR-002 D5).

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Required. One of MRD|PRD|FR|SDD|ADR|WO|ART|FB (DocKind).

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required, 1-300 chars.

properties.name: body
properties.description: Required. Normalized markdown body with frontmatter stripped.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Required. Free string; default depends on label (draft/active/pending/new, see DEFAULT_STATUS). WorkOrder further constrains this to pending|in_progress|done|out_of_sync|archived.

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Required (defaults to []). Free-form tags from frontmatter.

properties.name: tags_text
properties.description: Required. tags.join(' '); exists only so tags participate in the node_text_v2 fulltext index (fulltext cannot index list properties directly).

properties.name: source_path
properties.description: Required. Repo-relative path to the source markdown file.

properties.name: created_at
properties.description: Optional (null when absent). ISO date.

properties.name: content_hash
properties.description: Required. sha256 over a stable subset of frontmatter + body, excluding volatile fields and (for blueprints) the Tareas/Tasks section (ADR-002 D9).

nodes.label: Feature
nodes.description: Product requirement: MRD, PRD or FR. Always also carries :Node. Default status: draft.

properties.name: justified_by
properties.description: Required (always present; defaults to [] when the frontmatter key is omitted). Explicit ids of Feedback/Artifact that justify this feature; merged with the reverse of INFORMS/PROVIDES_CONTEXT_FOR to build JUSTIFIED_BY (ADR-002 D17).

properties.name: closed_at
properties.description: Optional (null when not closed). ISO datetime written by `prdm close` (ADR-002 D15).

properties.name: closed_by
properties.description: Optional (null when not closed). Actor pattern agent:name | dev:name.

properties.name: close_reason
properties.description: Optional (null unless force-closed). Free-form justification written by forceCloseFeature (SDD-018).

properties.name: closed_forced
properties.description: Required (defaults to false). True when this feature was closed via forceCloseFeature bypassing one or more otherwise-blocking readiness checks (SDD-018).

nodes.label: Blueprint
nodes.description: Technical architecture: SDD or ADR. Always also carries :Node. Default status: active.

properties.name: impacts_paths
properties.description: Required (defaults to []). Glob patterns this blueprint governs; drives CodeRef resolution and GOVERNED_BY. Legacy frontmatter alias `governs` is normalized to `impacts_paths` before parsing and hashed under the historical `governs` key (ADR-002 D9).

nodes.label: WorkOrder
nodes.description: Actionable task implementing one or more blueprints. Always also carries :Node. Default/initial status: pending; enum pending|in_progress|done|out_of_sync|archived.

properties.name: assigned_to
properties.description: Optional (null when unassigned). Actor pattern agent:name | dev:name; also drives the ASSIGNED_TO edge and the (:Actor) node.

properties.name: claimed_at
properties.description: Optional (null when not claimed). ISO datetime.

properties.name: completed_at
properties.description: Optional (null when not completed). ISO datetime.

properties.name: resolved_by
properties.description: Required (defaults to []). Commit SHAs that closed this work order.

properties.name: impacts_paths
properties.description: Required (defaults to []). Same shape as Blueprint.impacts_paths, scoped to this work order.

properties.name: source_task
properties.description: Optional (null when absent). Free-form provenance string, max 64 chars.

properties.name: archived_at
properties.description: Optional (null unless archived). ISO datetime written by archiveWorkOrder (SDD-018).

properties.name: archived_by
properties.description: Optional (null unless archived). Actor pattern agent:name | dev:name.

properties.name: archive_reason
properties.description: Optional (null when absent). Free-form justification written by archiveWorkOrder (SDD-018).

metadata.note: frontmatter.blueprint_hashes is NOT written to the graph (see x-prdm.discrepancies); it lives only in the markdown file and is read from disk by sync/monitor.ts.

nodes.label: Artifact
nodes.description: Supporting context: meeting notes, email, call transcript, etc. Always also carries :Node. Default status: active.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Required (defaults to 'other'). One of meeting|email|slack|call|doc|other.

properties.name: root
properties.description: Required (always present; defaults to false). Exempts this artifact from the 'must link a Feature' lifecycle rule (SDD-002 'Ciclo de vida').

nodes.label: Feedback
nodes.description: User feedback informing one or more features. Always also carries :Node. Default status: new.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Required (defaults to 'other'). Free string, max 60 chars (looser than Artifact.source, no enum).

properties.name: customer
properties.description: Optional (null when absent).

properties.name: root
properties.description: Required (always present; defaults to false). Same lifecycle exemption as Artifact.root.

nodes.label: CodeRef
nodes.description: Reference to a code file or symbol resolved from a Blueprint/WorkOrder's impacts_paths globs. Derived data: fully rebuilt every writeSnapshot, never authored.

key_property.name: key
key_property.description: Path (optionally path::symbol). Unique only in combination with project_id (see x-prdm.constraints.coderef_project_key).

properties.name: project_id
properties.description: Required.

properties.name: path
properties.description: Required. Repo-relative file path.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: Optional (null when the ref is file-level, not symbol-level).

properties.name: hash
properties.description: Optional (null when the path could not be hashed, e.g. deleted file). Content hash used to detect code_changed drift.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: Required. Always 'code:' + key; stable identifier returned in query projections.

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.description: Git commit that may resolve one or more work orders via a `Refs:` trailer. Derived data: fully rebuilt every writeSnapshot from `git log` (bounded by gitMaxCommits), never authored.

key_property.name: sha
key_property.description: Full commit SHA (7-40 lowercase hex, SHA_PATTERN). Unique only in combination with project_id (see x-prdm.constraints.commit_project_sha).

properties.name: project_id
properties.description: Required.

properties.name: author
properties.description: Required.

properties.name: date
properties.description: Required. ISO datetime of the commit.

properties.name: subject
properties.description: Required. Commit subject line (NOT 'message' -- corrected from the pre-multi-project doc).

properties.name: refs
properties.description: Required (defaults to []). Work order ids parsed from the commit's `Refs:` trailer; drives the RESOLVES edge.

properties.name: files
properties.description: Required (defaults to []). Files touched by this commit.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: Required. Always 'commit:' + sha.slice(0,7); stable identifier returned in query projections.

nodes.label: Actor
nodes.description: Developer or AI agent a work order is assigned to. Derived data: (re)created from WorkOrder.assigned_to every writeSnapshot.

key_property.name: id
key_property.description: ACTOR_PATTERN: agent:name | dev:name. Unique only in combination with project_id (see x-prdm.constraints.actor_project_id).

properties.name: project_id
properties.description: Required.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: Required. ai_agent | developer, derived from the id's agent:/dev: prefix.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: Required. Always 'actor:' + id.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required. Always equal to id.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.description: One row per registered project/checkout partition (ADR-002 D2/D6). Not deleted by GraphStore.clear(); only prdm project drop removes it.

key_property.name: id
key_property.description: prj_ + 16 hex chars, globally unique (bare uniqueness constraint, not composite).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Required.

properties.name: root_fingerprint
properties.description: Required. Realpath of the checkout that currently owns this partition; a mismatch on writeSnapshot throws ProjectFingerprintMismatch unless `prdm project claim` reassigns it.

properties.name: updated_at
properties.description: Required. ISO datetime of the last writeSnapshot/claim.

nodes.label: SchemaMigration
nodes.description: Bookkeeping row per applied migration (ADR-002 D3). Never deleted by any GraphStore/dropProject operation.

key_property.name: version
key_property.description: Globally unique (bare uniqueness constraint, not composite; not project-scoped -- migrations apply once per database).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Required. e.g. 'initial_schema', 'multi_project'.

properties.name: checksum
properties.description: Required. sha256 of the migration's statements; a mismatch with the running build's checksum is a hard error.

properties.name: applied_at
properties.description: Required. ISO datetime.

relationships.description: Feature hierarchy/evolution. Built from the union of a Feature's own `implements` and `evolves_from` frontmatter ids (both collapse onto this single edge type).

properties.name: review_needed
properties.description: Always present (true/false, never absent). Set when the blueprint's content_hash diverges from the baseline the feature-side WorkOrders were built against.

relationships.description: Work order implements one or more blueprints.
Artifact provides context for a feature; its reverse also feeds JUSTIFIED_BY.
Feedback informs a feature's evolution; its reverse also feeds JUSTIFIED_BY.
Derived from the reverse of INFORMS plus the feature's own explicit `justified_by` (ADR-002 D17). See also JUSTIFIED_BY (Feature -> Artifact).
Derived from the reverse of PROVIDES_CONTEXT_FOR plus the feature's own explicit `justified_by` (ADR-002 D17). See also JUSTIFIED_BY (Feature -> Feedback).

properties.name: status
properties.description: Required. synced | out_of_sync.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Required. One of unchanged|new|resolved_by_commit|code_changed|missing|blueprint_changed|feature_changed (GovernedReason).

relationships.description: Code governed by a blueprint; tracks drift/sync status (ADR-002 D16 for cross-blueprint coverage rules).
Commit resolves a work order via its `Refs:` trailer.
Work order assigned to a developer or AI agent.

Every Feature|Blueprint|WorkOrder|Artifact|Feedback node belongs to exactly one Project (ADR-002 D2). Excluded from GET_NODE/workOrderContext link projections (it is infrastructure, not domain context).
Same BELONGS_TO type as (Node)->(Project), for the CodeRef label.
Same BELONGS_TO type as (Node)->(Project), for the Commit label.
Same BELONGS_TO type as (Node)->(Project), for the Actor label.

x-prdm.compositeKeyLimitation: mcp-neo4j-data-modeling@0.8.2's Node.key_property accepts exactly one property, so it cannot express this schema's composite (project_id, <key>) uniqueness constraints. Every node above uses its natural key (id/key/sha/version) as key_property; the real constraint (bare or composite) is listed in x-prdm.constraints, sourced 1:1 from packages/core/src/graph/migrations.ts V2_STATEMENTS.

indexes.name: node_text_v2
indexes.label: Node
indexes.analyzerNote: Not set explicitly by CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX in migrations.ts (no OPTIONS clause) -- this is Neo4j 2026.08.1's default fulltext analyzer, empirically confirmed via SHOW INDEXES in graph-model.test.ts. ADR-002 D5 documents 'standard-no-stop-words' as if configured; it is actually inherited from the server default. See x-prdm.discrepancies.

discrepancies: ADR-002 D5 states the node_text_v2 fulltext index 'incluye project_id con standard-no-stop-words', implying the analyzer is configured. The actual migration statement (V2_STATEMENTS in migrations.ts) has no OPTIONS clause, so 'standard-no-stop-words' is Neo4j's server default, not an explicit setting; confirmed via SHOW INDEXES against Neo4j 2026.08.1 community. Not a functional bug (the default matches D5), but D5 would silently stop being true if Neo4j ever changes its default analyzer. Reported, not fixed (migrations.ts is read-only for this WO).

The pre-existing docs/model/graph-model.json (PRD-001-era) listed several graph properties that do not exist anywhere in code: Node.baseline_hash (baseline lives in a separate baseline.json file per project, per packages/core/src/sync/baseline.ts, never written to the graph) and WorkOrder.blueprint_hashes (a WO frontmatter field read by sync/monitor.ts and migrate/docs.ts, but explicitly excluded from the graph node's extraProps in parser/frontmatter.ts -- it is volatile status bookkeeping, not graph context). Both are omitted from this rewrite. Reported for visibility only; no source change made.

The pre-existing doc also had Commit.message/committed_at, node_text (v1, dropped by migration 2), and bare per-label uniqueness constraints (node_id/coderef_key/commit_sha/actor_id, also dropped by migration 2) -- all stale relative to the current schema version (2). Corrected in this rewrite; no source change needed since the code was already correct.
